name: Baked Spicy Cajun Chicken with Creamed Corn & Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Combine flour and spices in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 ½ tbsp paprika
1 tbsp garlic powder
1 tbsp onion powder
1 tbsp thyme
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat chicken with oil. Add drumsticks one by one to the bowl with the spices, rolling and pressing to adhere on all sides. Place chicken on baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken drumsticks
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add corn to the colander and rinse under hot water for several minutes to defrost. Set aside to drain.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add flour and whisk until smooth. Slowly add cream, whisking to make sure no lumps form. Stir in corn, salt, and pepper. Cover pan; remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp all-purpose flour
177 ml heavy cream
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash green beans and trim ends.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add green beans to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing frequently, until bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes. Remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the chicken, creamed corn, and green beans between plates. Enjoy!
